name: prism-ztna
description: Prism ZTNA replaces the VPN with per-request decisions. A small policy language (apps, allow/deny rules, attribute conditions, step-up MFA) is parsed by a Pratt parser and evaluated with deny-overrides and default deny, and every decision explains itself rule by rule. Device posture is scored from disk encryption, EDR, patch age, jailbreak and MDM signals. Sessions use device-bound HS256 tokens with key rotation, posture is re-checked on every request, and traffic is routed through an anycast PoP mesh to outbound-only app connectors. It ships with a hash-chained audit log, a policy linter, an identity-aware HTTP reverse proxy and a CLI.
author: Soumya Bhandare (krishyaa06)
